_comment: Authored analysis: ownership, lifecycle, refcount and locking judgements that no composer can derive, keyed to the C entities they describe. The structural half of each record (field layout, signatures, footprints, casts) is composed from the CodeQL tables on demand and merged in at read time, so a re-extract rewrites nothing here. Written only by `wavefront <repo> <target> query {types,symbols} --update`; read through wavefront.manifests. Hand-edit at your own risk: `--update` validates a submission against the composed skeleton (unknown field, wrong kind, ptr-invariant violation) and this file does not.

ptr.note: Array of nmemb elements of size bytes, ZEROED (av_mallocz); also one zeroed object when nmemb is 1 (av_calloc(1, sizeof(RNNModel)) in libavfilter/af_arnndn.c, av_calloc(1, sizeof(*fc->ft)) in libavcodec/vvc/thread.c). NULL also when nmemb*size overflows size_t. Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

Releases any block from the av_malloc family (av_malloc/mallocz/calloc/malloc_array/memdup/realloc*/strdup): free(), or _aligned_free with HAVE_ALIGNED_MALLOC. NULL is a no-op. Type-erased: one object or an array of any element type; never reads the contents.

Declared void* but is a T** slot (memcpy'd through to dodge aliasing). Reads the pointer held in the slot, stores NULL into the slot, then av_free()s the old pointee (NULL pointee is a no-op). The slot itself is borrowed and must be non-NULL; the pointee's ownership transfers in.

NOT zeroed (uninitialised; poisoned with 0x2a only under CONFIG_MEMORY_POISONING). Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

Array of nmemb elements of size bytes, NOT zeroed. NULL also when nmemb*size overflows size_t. Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

ZEROED (av_malloc + memset 0). Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

Read-only source of size bytes, any allocator; only read for the call. NULL source returns NULL. One object as well as an array: av_memdup(ctx, sizeof(DNXHDEncContext)) in libavcodec/dnxhdenc.c and av_memdup(s, slice_size) in libavcodec/mpegvideo.c copy a single context struct.

Fresh av_malloc(size) block holding a byte copy of p (deep clone): one object (the per-thread context copies in dnxhdenc.c / mpegvideo.c) or an array. NULL when p is NULL or allocation fails. size 0 yields a 1-byte block. Released by av_free.
Old block, ownership taken: realloc(ptr, size + !size). On failure (NULL return) the old block is NOT freed and stays owned by the caller. Only malloc alignment (16 on glibc x86_64), not ALIGN.

Resized block; NULL on failure or size > max_alloc_size. realloc-style: releases and reallocates the same slot, so not a constructor (schema); no lifecycle role. The raw-lifetime void tier binds av_free/av_malloc*/av_memdup instead.
